content: Jesukristuka ñukanchima shamurka Yayan Diosta riksichinanpa
Ñawpa Yaya Dioska kacharka paypa yachayninwa yachachikkunata, yaya rukunchi wañukunata achka kuti yachachinankunapa chikan chikan yachachinakunawa.

Ashwan kunan kay allpa tukurihushkan punchakunapi Wawan Jesukristutami kacharka yuyarishkanta ñukanchita riksichinanpa. Manara nima ima tiyahushpanrami Yaya Dioska Wawanwa pakta tukuy tiyashkata rurarka. Chaymanta payta churarka tukuyta kamachik kananpa.

Jesukristumi ñukanchita riksichin Yayan Dios chuyahlla punchashina yapa ali, chaymantapas atun yachayyu kananta. Pay tukuy kananwa rikuchishkanwa riksichin imashnami Yaya Dioska. Payka yapa yachayyu rimashkanllawa tukuy ima tiyakkunata kuyran. Paymi kay allpama shamushpan ñukanchiranti wañushpan uchanchikunamanta picharka. Chaywashami siluma rishpan tukuymanta pasa atun yachayyu Yayan Diospa kuskan partima tiyarirka paywa pakta tukuyta kamachinanpa.
Yaya Diospa Wawanka angelkunamanta pasa yachayyumi kan
Yaya Dios Jesukristuta churarka tukuy angelkunamanta ashwan yachayyu kananpa. Payta Wawayni nishpan tukuy angelkunamanta pasa kananta rikuchirka.

content.text: Kanka kikin wawaynimi kanki, kunan kanta wawata rurashkaynirayku nishpa.
Ñukaka yayaykimi kani, kanka kikin wawaynimi kanki nishpa.

content: Chaymanta Yaya Dioska shuklla Wawanta kay allpama kachahushpan tukuy paypa angelkunata rimarka:

content.text: Paykunataka wayratashinami, nina sintihuktashinami kachani munashkaynita ruranankunapa nishpa.
Kanka Dios kashpaykimi kamachinki wiñayparayku. Kuska alillatami kamachinki.

Kanka alillata munakmi kanki, chikninkimi millaypa ruranakunata. Chayraykumi ñuka Yayayki Dioska kanta akllashkani kamachinaykipa. Tukuy runa masikikunamanta kantaka ashwantami kushillayachisha nishpa.
Kan Dios kashpaykimi nima ima tiyashpanra allpata silutapas rurashkanki.
Tukuy chaykunaka chinkarinkakunami, ashwan kanka chasnalla wiñaypa kawsanki.
Tukuy chaykunaka churarinashinami mawkayashpan liki liki tukunkakuna.
Chasna tukushpankuna shuk mawka churarinatashinami wichunki.
Shuk mawka churarinata mushuwa kampyahukshina chay mawka allpata, mawka siluta wichushpa mushutana ruranki.
Tukuy allpa silu tukurishpankunapas kanka tukuy uras chasnallami kanki, wiñaypata kawsanki nishpa.
Kuskayni parti tiyariy kamachinaykipa ñukawa pakta, kanta chiknik runakunata winsinaynikama kanta kasunankunapana nishpa.

content: Manami nima shuk paypa angelkunata chasna rimarkachu.
Angelkunaka Yaya Diostami alita kasuk kanahun. Chasna kasuk kashpankunami Yaya Dioska paykunataka kachan, tukuy maykankunami kishpina kankakuna, chaykunata yanapanankunapa.

footnotes.text: Rikuy Jesukristuta Katikkunamanta Kwintak Killkapi 13.33, Hebreo Runakunarayku Killkapi 5.5, Biblia kastellanopi Salmos 2.7
